data.acceptance:
1. Every v2 write atomically records its immutable event bundle and pending outbox receipt before materialized-cache mutation.
2. Push registers a random installation writer epoch through expected-control-head CAS and updates only its credential-scoped inbox by expected-head fast-forward.
3. An event is acknowledged only after its remote inbox OID is confirmed; crash retries and lost acknowledgements deduplicate by exact event ID and content hash.
4. Replica history is never scanned or republished, and acknowledged pre-checkpoint paths cannot be resurrected.
5. Unseen local legacy events survive upgrade and are imported or quarantined without deleting legacy files.
